label: Bench our-way-prod GPS flake is grader-search variance plus terminate exit-code artifact not a daemon crash evidence chunk 2
title: Bench our-way-prod GPS flake is grader-search variance plus terminate exit-code artifact not a daemon crash evidence chunk 2
summary: (2) The real failure is RETRIEVAL VARIANCE, not "candidates=[]". For the GPS probe, only ONE chunk (knowledge:source_chunk:note-mqshctxxe4q#note-evidence:chunk-7, ~864 chars, starts with "your dealership was able to resolve the issue with your GPS system") carries the answer. autowireNewTaskWholeGraph seeds only the top-5 PARENT note nodes (TASK_CREATE_FANOUT=5 in daemon.js; chunks are not seeded), and the GPS parent note note-mqshctxxe4q is frequently displaced from the top-5 by the off-topic gas-rewards/detailing notes (the question "first issue after first service" is semantically distant from "dealership fixed the GPS"). The our-way-prod arm's grader path (POST /subconscious/search-context -> runAgenticContextSearches + gradeSearchRound) then does LLM-driven multi-round query reformulation; chunk-7 surfaces at cosine 0.439 ONLY when a round reformulates toward car/GPS/navigation terms. So it is a coin-flip per run: when chunk-7 is retrieved+kept the answer is correctly "GPS system issue" (verified twice, delivered_summary_len=864 GPS_in_delivered=True), when a non-GPS chunk wins the answer is "I don't know" (verified: grader kept note-mqshcse2si1#chunk-1, 618 chars, no GPS).
